name: International Stable Currency
oneLiner: ISC is a purchasing-power token tracking a basket of physical gold, investment-grade bonds, T-bills, global equities, and cash; price appreciates over time.
collateral: Basket of real-world assets (gold, bonds, T-bills, equity, cash)
pegMechanism: RWA-indexed basket tracking purchasing power; price appreciates over time

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: ISC's official whitepaper describes issuance and recall of ISC loans to a reserve that buys and sells a real-world asset basket. The earliest recorded mintToChecked transaction from the current SPL mint authority is dated 2023-11-20. Together these establish the current Solana implementation boundary and support the rwa-credit-fund classification.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ISC has a single Solana deployment in the reviewed metadata and no sourced bridge, lockbox, or cross-chain route was resolved. Pharos treats this secondary-triage row as single-chain/native.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-4 (lead dai-makerdao)

routes.reviewNote: ISC is native on Solana: mint and freeze authority are the reviewed 2-of-3 SPL multisig 3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ (mint-authority profile).

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: ISC's Solana mint has a non-null freeze authority, and Solana token accounts can be frozen when a mint retains freeze authority. That is direct holder-account freeze capability.

reserves.issuerOrObligor: Undisclosed ISC reserve managers, custodians, and asset providers

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: ISC's whitepaper specifies an initial target allocation of 20% each to global equity, gold, global bonds, short-term Treasuries, and cash, but directs readers to a dashboard for the current allocation. The reviewed dashboard did not expose a dated, verifiable holdings snapshot. Because the initial target is not evidence of current holdings, the prior five equal-weight rows have been replaced by one 100% unresolved multi-asset envelope.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: ISC whitepaper target asset families; current allocation unavailable
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current reserve allocation, holdings, custody providers, valuation date, liability reconciliation, and implementation launch date are not established by the reviewed primary sources.

providers.name: ISC Reserve accounts and undisclosed reserve managers

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The whitepaper describes a community-governed ISC Reserve basket but does not name custody providers, account segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation terms, or the managers behind the target allocation.

mintAuthority.summary: ISC is a standard Solana SPL token whose mint and freeze authority is immutable 2-of-3 SPL Token multisig 3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ. Its three signers are on-curve externally signable public keys. The mint and multisig are governed only by the immutable Token Program; no custom upgradeable program sits in the issuance path.

controls.label: ISC SPL 2-of-3 mint multisig
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 432714278, mint J9BcrQfX4p9D1bvLzRNCbMDv8f44a9LFdeqNE4Yk2WMD returned mintAuthority and freezeAuthority 3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ. That Token Program-owned account decoded as an immutable SPL multisig with threshold 2 and signers B6PG7xN8W1G3PA8XoTzUEAdzNzWfDXQeWud5axWtHCPi, FUPe37ryYxB2J8Ckvq3pzpw7EMahYyeT8WtzJqh3Ge3f, and 3kHz9pTwSeCz6JemWsKoKMPS8E1RUbwbU2xg1b1ajFGF. All three are on-curve externally signable public keys. Tokenkeg ProgramData had no upgrade authority.
